name: Futanari Kanojo no Benkyou Seikatsu
original_name: ふたなりカノジョの勉強性活
source:
Nanami, the futanari girl, was getting some study help from her older boyfriend. 
He told her that if she got 20 points above the average score, he would give her a "reward".
But until the test was finished, they would not be allowed to have sex...

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE248709.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
扶她女孩七海接受年长男友的学习辅导。
他告诉她，只要考试成绩高于平均分20分，就会给她“奖励”。
但考试结束前，两人不允许发生性关系……
